Source Monster

Monster: Somnacanth | CR: 10 | Tier: 2

Compatible Slots: Armor, Weapon

Weapon Effect

Capture Expert. While you wield this weapon @item[tranq bomb|AGMH]s and @item[tranq ammo (1)|AGMH|tranq ammo] roll an extra [[/r 3d8]] when they hit a creature.

Armor Effect

Item Prolonger+. Whenever you use a consumable item that has a duration, its duration is increased by an additional 12 seconds.

Tags: mechanic:extra-damage:major, type:offensive
